candidates.formal_type:
∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {r : Nat} {d : Fin r → Nat} [∀ (i : Fin r), NeZero.{0} (d i)],
  And (∀ (j : Fin r), IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_1} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) (Fin (d j) → k))
    (And
      (∀ (W : Type u_2) [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} W] [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_2} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) W]
        [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k W] [IsScalarTower.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (MatProd.{u_1} k d) W]
        [FiniteDimensional.{u_1, u_2} k W] [IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) W],
        Exists.{1} fun j =>
          Nonempty.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1)}
            (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_1} (RingHom.id.{u_1} (MatProd.{u_1} k d)) W (Fin (d j) → k)))
      (∀ (X : Type u_3) [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} X] [inst_3 : Module.{u_1, u_3} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) X],
        IsSemisimpleModule.{u_1, u_3} (MatProd.{u_1} k d) X))
Type u_1 → {r : Nat} → (Fin r → Nat) → Type u_1
